reviews.name: Elvis Tabi
reviews.comment: Liah Academy provided the exact practical coding foundation I needed. Within 3 months of completing the Software Engineering track, I landed a remote developer role.

reviews.name: Nathalie Ewane
reviews.comment: The fiber optic labs and 24/7 power backup meant zero downtime during our semester hackathons. Top-tier mentors who actually work on enterprise software.

reviews.name: Roland Ashu
reviews.comment: The hands-on SOC labs in Bakweri Town transformed theoretical networking into real defense experience. Unmatched tech academy in Cameroon.

courses.title: Software Engineering (B.Tech / HND)
courses.description: Comprehensive software development covering data structures, fullstack TypeScript, Python backends, DevOps pipelines, database architectures, and distributed systems.
courses.modules: TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker, Git

courses.title: Cybersecurity & Cloud Defense (B.Sc)
courses.description: Hands-on network defense, ethical hacking, SOC monitoring, penetration testing, cryptography, and cloud infrastructure security labs.
courses.modules: Linux, Wireshark, Metasploit, Cryptography, AWS Security, SIEM

courses.title: DevOps & Cloud Engineering Specialist
courses.description: Master CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes container orchestration, Terraform infrastructure as code, cloud monitoring, and automated deployment architectures.
courses.modules: Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Terraform, AWS, Prometheus

courses.title: Data Science & Machine Learning
courses.description: Applied statistical modeling, deep learning architectures, Python data wrangling, NLP, computer vision, and production ML model deployment.
courses.modules: Python, Pandas, TensorFlow, PyTorch, SQL, PowerBI

courses.title: Computer Engineering (ND)
courses.description: Hardware architecture, electronic microcontrollers, IoT circuits, local network setup, system diagnostics, and low-level firmware engineering.
courses.modules: C++, Arduino, Circuit Design, Networking, Hardware Labs

courses.title: Web & Graphics Design (HND)
courses.description: Modern user interface design, Figma design systems, motion graphics, branding identity, responsive frontend frameworks, and client portal architecture.
courses.modules: Figma, Adobe XD, HTML5/CSS3, JavaScript, UI/UX Systems
